correctness.rationale: Direct trigonometric expansion establishes the exact double eigenvalue -9δ and the homogeneous quadratic term Q. The quotient-norm identity ||Q(w)||=(3sqrt(6)/8)||w||² is checked symbolically; an inward radial inequality gives a basin ball of radius 4sqrt(6)δ-O(δ²). The blow-up system has precisely one zero and three simple nonzero roots, each a saddle with norm 4sqrt(6), giving the opposite bound. The local root-exclusion argument and the finite tests are distinguished from the analytic proof.
